C1710.title: China's First Case of Illegal Cash-Out via Merchant QR Codes Cracked
C1710.summary: The Jiangdu branch of the Yangzhou Public Security Bureau disclosed that between August 2020 and April 2021, a criminal gang led by Sun used over 180 merchant QR codes to conduct credit card cash-outs through fictitious transactions. Members registered businesses nationwide to obtain QR codes, exploiting banks' zero-fee policies to cyclically extract cash and earn point rebates. The amount involved reached nearly 10 billion yuan, and 15 core suspects were subjected to coercive measures.

references.title: Nearly 10 billion yuan involved: Jiangdu police crack China's first QR-code cash-out case
